title: Daily Standup: Cập nhật tiến độ rõ ràng
summary: Luyện một quy ước nhóm để báo cáo tiến độ hướng tới Sprint Goal, priority và blocker có next action trong 60 giây.
learningObjectives: Nêu tiến độ liên quan tới Sprint Goal
Nêu blocker hoặc risk cùng next action

sections.title: A concise team update
sections.content: Sprint Goal: make signup and payment ready for partner beta. Yesterday: completed signup validation and tests. Today: deploy to staging and reproduce the payment timeout so the team can identify the failing dependency. Blocker: payment dashboard access; platform team has the request; fallback is pairing with Linh.

provenance.adaptationNote: Names, metrics, tickets and incidents are fictional training data. The three-part update is a team convention, not a Scrum requirement.

expressions.meaning: Nêu completed outcome và liên hệ nó với Sprint Goal hoặc kết quả của nhóm.
expressions.example: Yesterday, I completed signup validation, which closed the main error cases.

expressions.phrase: Today, I will ___ so we can ___.
expressions.meaning: Nêu một priority cùng expected result.
expressions.example: Today, I will reproduce the timeout so we can identify the failing dependency.
alternatives: My priority today is ___ so that ___.

expressions.phrase: I am blocked by ___, which prevents ___.
expressions.meaning: Nêu blocker cùng impact cụ thể.
expressions.example: I am blocked by dashboard access, which prevents provider comparison.

expressions.phrase: I have asked ___; meanwhile, I will ___.
expressions.meaning: Nêu owner của request và fallback để công việc vẫn tiến triển.
expressions.example: I have asked Platform; meanwhile, I will pair with Linh.

exercises.question: Which update names a blocker and next action?
options: Payment dashboard access is slowing the comparison, and I may need Platform to help at some stage.
Payment dashboard access is blocking comparison, so I asked Platform for permission.
I may need access later, depending on the investigation.
correctAnswer: Payment dashboard access is blocking comparison, so I asked Platform for permission.
exercises.explanation: A useful blocker names what is missing, its effect and the action already taken.

exercises.question: Which sentence gives both today's priority and its expected result?
options: Today, I will reproduce the timeout so we can identify the failing dependency.
Today, I will work on the payment issue and share an update.
Today, the payment investigation remains our general priority.
correctAnswer: Today, I will reproduce the timeout so we can identify the failing dependency.
exercises.explanation: The sentence pairs a concrete action with the result the team expects from that action.

exercises.question: Which no-blocker update still makes a real risk actionable?
options: I have no blocker; store review may delay release, so I will check approval by 15:00.
I have no blocker, but release timing may change.
The store review is a risk, and the release team already knows about it.
correctAnswer: I have no blocker; store review may delay release, so I will check approval by 15:00.
exercises.explanation: It separates blocker status from a named risk and gives that risk an owner action with a deadline.

performanceTask.title: Deliver a concise Daily Standup
performanceTask.scenario: Tình huống mô phỏng: bạn cập nhật cho một distributed engineering team bằng quy ước ba phần của nhóm.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: Trong 30–60 giây, dùng quy ước nhóm yesterday, today và blocker mà chưa xem model/chunks.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Trong 30–60 giây, nói bằng tiếng Anh và dùng facts chính: Sprint Goal progress, completed outcome, priority/expected result, blocker impact và next action.
performanceTask.modelResponse: Signup validation and tests are complete, moving us toward the partner-beta Sprint Goal. Today, I will deploy to staging and reproduce the payment timeout so we can identify the failing dependency. Dashboard access is blocking the comparison, so I asked Platform and will pair with Linh if access is delayed. I have no other blockers right now.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Trong 30–60 giây, dùng search-index case mới và sửa criterion cần tập trung.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Trong 30–60 giây, không xem model/chunks: cập nhật incident 503 với plan, estimate và collaborator.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Trong 30–60 giây, từ brief mới, deliver a concise standup linked to the Sprint Goal, with no blocker and one risk.

rubric.label: Three-part team convention
rubric.description: The listener can connect the update to the Sprint Goal and separate completed work, the next priority with its expected result, and blocker status. This scaffold is not a Scrum requirement.

rubric.label: Technical specificity
rubric.description: Names a concrete feature, service, test, environment or metric.

rubric.label: Actionable blocker
rubric.description: States impact and next action, or clearly confirms no blocker.

audio.text: Yesterday, I completed the validation tests.
Today, I will reproduce the timeout.
My blocker is access to the payment dashboard.
If access is delayed, I will pair with Linh.

training.question: Which section is this?
training.feedback: Stress YESTERDAY and the completed result.

audio.text: Today, I will deploy and monitor error rates so we can confirm the fix is stable.

training.question: What is included?
options: Blocker and a request for help
training.feedback: The so we can clause makes the expected result explicit.

audio.text: I am blocked by missing test credentials.

training.question: What is the blocker?
training.feedback: Make BLOCKED and TEST CREDENTIALS prominent.

audio.text: I asked QA for access and will use a mock account meanwhile.

training.question: What makes this actionable?
options: A complaint with no next step
training.feedback: Link request and fallback in separate thought groups.

audio.text: I have no blockers at the moment.

training.question: What status is reported?
training.feedback: Say no blockers explicitly when true.

audio.text: My estimate is one day after the test data arrives.

training.question: What condition affects the estimate?
options: Test data is reviewed by QA
training.feedback: Keep the condition attached to the estimate.

audio.text: Yesterday, I finished the feature flag cleanup.
Today, I will verify five hundred beta accounts.
Meanwhile, I will use a local mock account.

posttest.question: What is the next action?
options: Work with a local mock account
posttest.correctAnswer: Work with a local mock account

pronunciationCues.articulatoryCue: Nhấn YESTERDAY ở đầu câu để người nghe nhận ra completed outcome.
pronunciationCues.meaningRisk: Thiếu signpost khiến phần công việc đã hoàn thành khó phân biệt với kế hoạch hôm nay.

pronunciationCues.articulatoryCue: Giữ âm cuối /s/ trong access và /z/ ở cuối credentials; nhấn từ chỉ blocker.
pronunciationCues.meaningRisk: Mất âm cuối có thể làm người nghe khó nhận ra dependency đang thiếu.
